evidence: decorative_mascot: hook@0.3 to seg0:end: Data just steps from bar to bar. seg1:mid/end: he stands in the corner waving. seg2:mid/end: he poses beside the cup doing nothing. seg4:start to payoff@-0.4: he is pinned to the left edge pointing, and never interacts with the numbers.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:mid/end: a cup of water drains from '697,954 left of 750,000' to '563,971 left of 750,000' with the caption 'only 74% stay'. The script says 750,000 km² were LOST in total and compares that to France. A cyan ellipse also covers the headline number.
weakest_scene.root_cause: A generic 'leaking vessel' machine was applied to a cumulative-loss total. It invented a remaining-stock number and a retention percentage that the data does not contain, and dropped the France comparison the narration is making.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show the cumulative 750,000 km² as area. Clear forest cells year by year until the cleared area outgrows a France outline (551,695 km²) drawn at the same scale. No invented 'left' or '% stay' numbers, and no mark overlapping the label.
